set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-mapping.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Extract the named reconstruction profile and pure decision operation from historical bench code. Preserve recorded historical anchors; raw argmax, chosen mass and requested fill stay distinct. Consume the checked G1 evidence seam.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Current prerequisites (replace historical dependency prose): bd-01M2TACM78289S4TECE91GT5K2

Scheduling lane: next. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: decode; lane: next.

Scope: align structured decision policies, embed-bench MonotoneScene/RecallToVideo

Acceptance criteria:
1. Move pure structured decision logic/config into the library; named versioned reconstruction profile declares persistence/order/hierarchy/causal/external/refinement/fill choices. Keep historical Sherlock preset explicit.
2. No fill by default for new explicit profiles; historical fill remains available only by request. Raw evidence and posterior immutable; raw argmax, chosen target, chosen mass and fill origin exported separately.
3. Same recorded inputs/config reproduce historical anchor bytes. Config changes alter policy identity; no raw-argmax confidence is attached to a different chosen target.
4. Structured output cannot satisfy strict reference compatibility. No transfer decoder tuning in this extraction; generic configuration does not require a corpus-schema research comparison.

Validation: existing MonotoneScene suites plus proposed ReconstructionPolicySuite

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: Supersedes generic decoder extraction only; H2 is later reconstruction research.
